title: Claude Code enables free local AI coding without subscriptions or API calls #claudecode #opensource
description:
Claude Code became free to run locally on your laptop, eliminating the need for a subscription or API calls. By installing Alima and using models like Qwen 3, users can now operate Claude Code without an internet connection, preserving privacy and avoiding usage costs.

This shift reflects a growing trend in AI towards accessible open-source models that rival commercial offerings in quality and convenience. Running advanced AI directly on personal devices reduces dependency on cloud services and subscription fees, creating opportunities for developers and businesses to innovate more cost-effectively.

While frontier AI models still lead in performance, local deployment is rapidly closing the gap, signaling a potential market shift towards self-hosted AI solutions that prioritize user control and affordability.
